title: House and Well
author: Rosalind Nystrom
blurb: Astrid Brightwater, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
